definitions.meaning: The term of the Lease shall be for eighty-six (86) months (or until sooner terminated as herein provided), beginning on (i) February 1, 2007 or (ii) the Commencement Date, whichever shall last occur, except that if the Commencement Date is other than the first day of a calendar month, the term shall be extended for the remainder of that calendar month.
definitions.sourceText: The term of the Lease shall be for eighty-six (86) months (or until sooner terminated as herein provided) (the "Lease Term"), beginning on (i) February 1, 2007 or (ii) the "Commencement Date" (as hereinafter defined), whichever shall last occur, except that if the Commencement Date is other than the first day of a calendar month, the term hereof shall be extended for the remainder of that calendar month.

definitions.meaning: The earlier of substantial completion of the Premises in accordance with Landlord's plans and specifications, but not earlier than February 1, 2007, or the date Tenant takes possession of any portion of the Premises, subject to acceleration for Tenant Delay.
definitions.sourceText: The Commencement Date shall be the earlier of (i) the date upon which the Premises have been substantially completed in accordance with the plans and specifications of Landlord ... but which shall not be deemed to have occurred earlier than February 1, 2007 regardless of the status of completion, or (ii) the date on which Tenant takes possession of a portion of or all of the Premises; provided, however, that if Landlord shall be delayed in such substantial completion as a result of any of the foregoing ... the Commencement Date and the payment of rent hereunder shall be accelerated by the number of days of such delay.

definitions.meaning: The date beginning five (5) months following the Commencement Date.
definitions.sourceText: Beginning five (5) months following the Commencement Date (the "Rental Start Date"), Tenant shall pay to Landlord throughout the term of this Lease rental as set forth below...

definitions.meaning: The base year for Direct Operating Expenses is calendar year 2007.
definitions.sourceText: ...incurred by Landlord in the operation of the Building during each calendar year of the Lease Term exceeds the Direct Operating Expenses for the base year 2007 (hereinafter called the "Base Year").

definitions.term: Tenant's Proportionate Share of Direct Operating Expenses
definitions.meaning: For each calendar year or portion thereof, the Operating Expense Amount multiplied by a fraction whose numerator is 46,978 rentable square feet and denominator is 410,571 rentable square feet.
definitions.sourceText: "Tenant's Proportionate Share of Direct Operating Expenses" shall mean, for each calendar year (or portion thereof), the product of (i) the Operating Expense Amount ... multiplied by (ii) a fraction, the numerator of which is the number of square feet contained in the Premises (46,978) and the denominator of which is the number of rentable square feet contained in the Building (410,571).

definitions.meaning: All operating costs for the Building, the Building's share of operating costs for any parking area and common area serving the Building, and the Property, subject to listed inclusions and exclusions.
definitions.sourceText: For purposes of this Lease, the term "Direct Operating Expenses" shall consist of all "operating costs" ... for the Building, and the Building’s share of all operating costs for any parking area and common area serving the Building, and the Property...

definitions.meaning: Four percentage points higher than the prime commercial lending rate from time to time of SunTrust Bank in Atlanta, Georgia, except that if such rate exceeds the maximum permitted by law, the maximum lawful rate applies.
definitions.sourceText: ...with interest at the rate of four percentage points higher than the prime commercial lending rate from time to time of SunTrust Bank in Atlanta, Georgia, provided, however, that if such rate exceeds the maximum rate permitted by law, the maximum lawful rate shall apply; the interest rate so determined is hereinafter called the "Agreed Interest Rate".

clauses.title: Term and Possession
clauses.sourceText: The term of the Lease shall be for eighty-six (86) months (or until sooner terminated as herein provided) (the "Lease Term"), beginning on (i) February 1, 2007 or (ii) the "Commencement Date" (as hereinafter defined), whichever shall last occur, except that if the Commencement Date is other than the first day of a calendar month, the term hereof shall be extended for the remainder of that calendar month.

effect.action: lease term continues for 86 months beginning on the later of february_1_2007 and commencement_date, extended through the remainder of the calendar month if commencement_date is not the first day of a calendar month

clauses.title: Monthly Rental
clauses.sourceText: Beginning five (5) months following the Commencement Date (the "Rental Start Date"), Tenant shall pay to Landlord throughout the term of this Lease rental as set forth below, payable in equal monthly rental installments and payable in advance on the first day of each month during every year of the term hereby demised in lawful money of the United States, without deduction or offset whatsoever.

effect.action: pay monthly rent installments in advance to landlord on the first day of each month beginning on the rental_start_date

clauses.title: Late Charge on Rent
clauses.sourceText: Tenant therefore agrees that if rent or any other payment due hereunder from Tenant to Landlord remains unpaid five (5) days after said amount is due, the amount of such unpaid rent or other payment shall be increased by a late charge to be paid to Landlord by Tenant in an amount equal to five percent (5%) of the amount of the delinquent rent or other payment.

clauses.title: Operating Expense Pass-Through
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall pay to Landlord as additional rent Tenant's proportionate share of the amount by which the Direct Operating Expenses incurred by Landlord in the operation of the Building during each calendar year of the Lease Term exceeds the Direct Operating Expenses for the base year 2007 ... "Tenant's Proportionate Share of Direct Operating Expenses" shall mean ... the Operating Expense Amount multiplied by ... a fraction, the numerator of which is ... 46,978 and the denominator of which is ... 410,571.

clauses.title: Security Deposit
clauses.sourceText: Tenant hereby deposits with Landlord on the date hereof the sum of Seventy Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty Six and 89/100 Dollars ($77,826.89), which sum shall be held by Landlord, without obligation for interest, as security for the full, timely and faithful performance of Tenant's covenants and obligations under this Lease.

clauses.title: Occupancy and Use
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall use and occupy the Premises for general office purposes and for no other use or purpose without the prior written consent of Landlord.

clauses.title: Compliance with Laws
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not use the Premises or permit anything to be done in or about the Premises which will in any way conflict with any law, statute, ordinance, or governmental rule, regulation or requirement now in force or which may hereafter be enacted or promulgated.

clauses.title: Hazardous Materials Indemnity
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not use, handle, store, deal in, discharge, or fabricate any Hazardous Materials on or about the Premises (except for typical office supplies maintained in compliance with all applicable laws and ordinances). Tenant shall indemnify Landlord ... from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses ... as a result of the existence of any Hazardous Materials on or about the Premises or any environmental problems relating to the Premises which are caused by or related to the delivery, deposit or creation of Hazardous Materials on or about the Premises during the term of this Lease.

effect.scope: claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses arising from hazardous materials or environmental problems on or about the premises caused by or related to tenant's delivery, deposit, or creation of hazardous materials during the lease term

clauses.title: Alterations
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not make or suffer to be made any alterations, additions, or improvements in, on, or to the Premises or any part thereof without the prior written consent of Landlord...

clauses.title: Repair
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall, at all times during the term hereof at Tenant's sole cost and expense, keep the Premises and every part thereof in good order, condition and repair, excepting ordinary wear and tear, damage thereto by fire, acts of terrorism, earthquake, act of God or the elements.

clauses.title: Liens
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall keep the Premises free from any liens arising out of any work performed, material furnished, or obligations incurred by Tenant.

clauses.title: Assignment and Subletting
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not sell, assign, encumber or otherwise transfer by operation of law or otherwise this Lease or any interest herein, sublet the Premises or any portion thereof, or suffer any other person to occupy or use the Premises or any portion thereof, without the prior written consent of Landlord...

clauses.title: Insurance and Indemnification - Waiver of Claims
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall not be liable to Tenant and Tenant hereby waives all claims against Landlord for any injury or damages to any person or property in or about the Premises by or from any cause whatsoever ... except to the extent arising from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of Landlord.

clauses.title: Insurance and Indemnification - Tenant Indemnity
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall hold Landlord harmless from and defend and indemnify Landlord against any and all claims or liability for any injury or damage to any person or property whatsoever: (i) occurring in, on or about the Premises ... when such injury or damage shall be caused in part or in whole by the act, neglect, fault of, or omission of any duty ... by Tenant, its agents, servants, employees, or invitees.

effect.scope: claims or liability for injury or damage occurring in, on, or about the premises or shared facilities, and claims relating to tenant's work, transactions, breaches, acts, or negligence

clauses.title: Insurance and Indemnification - Tenant Insurance
clauses.sourceText: Tenant agrees to purchase at its own expense and to keep in force during the term of this Lease all insurance coverages reasonably required by Landlord to be maintained by tenants in the Building generally, including, but not limited to, the policies of insurance specified on Exhibit "G" attached to this Lease.

clauses.title: Insurance and Indemnification - Landlord Indemnity
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall hold Tenant harmless from and defend and indemnify Tenant against any and all claims or liabilities for any injury or damage to any person or property whatsoever occurring in, on or about the Building or the Property, to the extent such injury or damage shall be caused by the grossly negligent acts or omissions of Landlord or Landlord's agents, employees or contractors.

clauses.title: Insurance and Indemnification - Landlord Property Insurance
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall maintain in force, at its sole cost and expense (but subject to reimbursement as Direct Operating Expenses), "All Risk" ... property insurance, covering the Building, for not less than its full replacement cost.

clauses.title: Waiver of Subrogation
clauses.sourceText: Each of Landlord and Tenant hereby releases the other from any and all liability or responsibility to the other or anyone claiming through or under them by way of subrogation or otherwise for any loss or damage to property caused by fire or any other perils insured in policies of insurance covering such property...

clauses.title: Service and Utilities
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall maintain the public and common areas of the Building ... in reasonably good order and condition typical for a first-class office building in metropolitan Atlanta, Georgia... Landlord agrees to furnish to the Premises during ordinary business hours ... heat and air-conditioning ... janitorial services ... and elevator service.

clauses.title: Estoppel Certificate
clauses.sourceText: Within seven (7) days following the Commencement Date or any written request which Landlord may make from time to time, Tenant shall execute and deliver to Landlord a certificate substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit "C"...

clauses.title: Holding Over
clauses.sourceText: If Tenant retains possession of the Premises or any part thereof after such termination ... the daily rental shall ... be equal to 150% of the rental being paid monthly to Landlord under this Lease immediately prior to such termination...

clauses.title: Subordination
clauses.sourceText: This Lease shall be subject and subordinate at all times to: (a) all ground leases or underlying leases ... and (b) the lien or interest of any mortgage or deed to secure debt...

clauses.title: Re-Entry by Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord reserves and shall ... have the right to re-enter the Premises to inspect the same, to supply janitor service and any other service to be provided by Landlord to Tenant hereunder, to show said Premises to prospective purchasers, mortgagees or tenants...

clauses.title: Insolvency or Bankruptcy
clauses.sourceText: The appointment of a receiver to take possession of all or substantially all of the assets of Tenant, or an assignment of Tenant for the benefit of creditors, or any action taken or suffered by Tenant under any insolvency, bankruptcy, or reorganization act, shall at Landlord's option constitute a breach of this Lease by Tenant. Upon the happening of any such event or at any time thereafter, this Lease shall terminate five (5) days after written notice of termination from Landlord to Tenant.

consequences: landlord may treat the event as a breach of the lease
lease terminates five days after written notice of termination from landlord to tenant

clauses.title: Default and Remedies
clauses.sourceText: Upon the occurrence of any such events of default described in this paragraph or elsewhere in this Lease, Landlord shall have the option to pursue any one or more of the following remedies without any notice or demand whatsoever: (aa) Landlord may, at its election, terminate this Lease or terminate Tenant's right to possession only... (bb) ... repossess the Premises ... (cc) ... recover as Landlord's actual accrued damages, all rent ... plus ... liquidated damages for the balance of the stated term ... (dd) ... relet the Premises ... and Tenant shall ... pay the cost thereof...

consequences: landlord may terminate the lease or tenant's right to possession
landlord may re-enter and repossess the premises
tenant remains liable for accrued rent and other sums due
landlord may recover liquidated damages for the remaining term
landlord may relet the premises and recover deficiencies and reletting costs
landlord may perform tenant's obligations and charge the cost as additional rent

clauses.title: Damage by Fire
clauses.sourceText: If the Building, improvements, or Premises are rendered partially or wholly untenantable by fire or other casualty, and if such damage cannot, in Landlord's reasonable estimation, be materially restored within one hundred eighty (180) days of such damage, then Landlord or Tenant may, at its sole option, terminate this Lease as of the date of such fire or casualty.

clauses.title: Condemnation
clauses.sourceText: If any substantial part of the Premises should be taken for any public or quasi-public use under governmental law, ordinance or regulation, or by right of eminent domain, or by private purchase in lieu thereof, and the taking would prevent or materially interfere with the use of the Premises for the purpose for which it is then being used, this Lease shall terminate effective when the physical taking shall occur...

clauses.title: Sale by Landlord
clauses.sourceText: In the event of a sale or conveyance by Landlord of the Building, the same shall operate to release Landlord from any future liability upon any of the covenants or conditions ... and in such event Tenant agrees to look solely to the responsibility of the successor in interest of Landlord...

clauses.title: Right of Landlord to Perform
clauses.sourceText: If Tenant shall fail to perform any acts, covenants or agreements to be performed by Tenant ... and such failure shall continue for fifteen (15) days after written notice thereof by Landlord, Landlord may, but shall not be obligated so to do ... make any such payment or perform any such act... All sums so paid by Landlord ... together with interest thereon at the Agreed Interest Rate ... shall be payable as additional rent to Landlord on demand.

clauses.title: Surrender of Premises
clauses.sourceText: At the end of the Lease Term, Tenant agrees to peaceably deliver up to the Landlord possession of the Premises, in the same condition as received on the Commencement Date, ordinary wear and tear, damage by fire, earthquake, and other acts of God excepted.

clauses.title: Waiver
clauses.sourceText: If either Landlord or Tenant waives the performance of any term, covenant or condition contained in this Lease, such waiver shall not be deemed to be a waiver of any subsequent breach of the same or any other term, covenant or condition contained herein.

clauses.title: Notices
clauses.sourceText: Whenever any notice, demand or request is required or permitted hereunder, such notice, demand or request shall be hand-delivered in person, by reputable courier service or sent by United States Mail, registered, postage prepaid, to the addresses set forth below...

clauses.title: Certain Rights Reserved to the Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord reserves and may exercise the following rights without affecting Tenant's obligations hereunder: (a) To change the name of the Building; ... (f) To take any and all measures ... as may be necessary or desirable for the safety, protection, preservation or security of the Premises or the Building...

clauses.title: Abandonment
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not vacate or abandon the Premises at any time during the term, and if Tenant shall abandon, vacate, or surrender said Premises ... any personal property belonging to Tenant and left on the Premises shall, at the option of Landlord, be deemed to be abandoned and title thereto shall thereupon pass to Landlord.

clauses.title: Successors and Assigns
clauses.sourceText: Subject to the provisions of Paragraph 9 hereof, the terms, covenants, and conditions contained herein shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the heirs, successors, executors, administrators and assigns of the parties hereto.

clauses.title: Attorneys' Fees
clauses.sourceText: In the event that any action or proceeding is brought to enforce any term, covenant or condition of this Lease on the part of Landlord or Tenant, the prevailing party in such litigation shall be entitled to reasonable attorneys' fees to be fixed by the Court in such action or proceeding.

clauses.title: Corporate Authority
clauses.sourceText: If Tenant signs as a corporation, each of the persons executing this Lease on behalf of Tenant does hereby covenant and warrant that Tenant is a duly authorized and existing corporation, that Tenant has and is qualified to do business in Georgia...

clauses.title: Mortgage Approvals
clauses.sourceText: Any provisions of this Lease requiring the approval or consent of Landlord shall not be deemed to have been unreasonably withheld if any mortgagee ... shall refuse or withhold its approval or consent thereto.

clauses.title: Miscellaneous
clauses.sourceText: Time is of the essence of this Lease and all of its provisions. This Lease shall in all respects be governed by the laws of the State of Georgia. This Lease, together with its exhibits, contains all the agreements of the parties hereto and supersedes any previous negotiations.

clauses.title: Landlord's Lien
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall have and Tenant hereby grants to Landlord a continuing security interest for all rentals and other sums of money becoming due hereunder from Tenant, upon all goods, wares, equipment, fixtures, furniture, inventory, accounts, contract rights, chattel paper and other personal property of Tenant situated on the Premises...

clauses.title: Quiet Enjoyment
clauses.sourceText: Landlord represents and warrants that it has full right and authority to enter into this Lease and that Tenant, while paying the rental and performing its other covenants and agreements herein set forth, shall peaceably and quietly have, hold and enjoy the Premises for the term hereof without hindrance or molestation from Landlord subject to the terms and provisions of this Lease.

clauses.title: Landlord's Liability
clauses.sourceText: In no event shall Landlord's liability for any breach of this Lease exceed the amount of rental then remaining unpaid for the then current term ... any liability of Landlord hereunder shall be enforceable only out of the interest of Landlord in the Building and the Property...

clauses.title: Right to Relocate
clauses.sourceText: [Intentionally omitted]

clauses.title: No Estate
clauses.sourceText: This contract shall create the relationship of Landlord and Tenant, and no estate shall pass out of Landlord. Tenant has only a usufruct, not subject to levy and sale and not assignable by Tenant, except as provided for herein and in compliance herewith.

clauses.title: Lease Effective Date
clauses.sourceText: Submission of this instrument for examination or signature by Tenant does not constitute a reservation of or option for lease, and it is not effective as a lease or otherwise until execution and delivery by both Landlord and Tenant.

clauses.title: Rules and Regulations
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall faithfully observe and comply with the rules and regulations printed on or annexed to this Lease as Exhibit "A" ... and all reasonable modifications thereof and additions thereto from time to time put into effect by Landlord.

clauses.title: Special Stipulations
clauses.sourceText: Special Stipulations to this Lease are set forth on Exhibit "E" attached hereto and made a part hereof. In the event of any conflict between any provision set forth in Exhibit "E" and any provision contained elsewhere in this Lease, the former in all events shall supersede, prevail and control.

clauses.title: Guaranty
clauses.sourceText: [Intentionally omitted]

clauses.title: Condition
clauses.sourceText: [Intentionally omitted]

clauses.title: Brokerage Commissions
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall indemnify and hold harmless Landlord and Landlord's agents from and against any and all claims for commissions or other compensation, and any liabilities, damages and costs relating thereto, that may be asserted by any person or entity other than Broker to the extent that Tenant has engaged such person or such claim results from any action of Tenant.

effect.scope: claims for commissions or other compensation and related liabilities, damages, and costs asserted by any broker or other person engaged by tenant or resulting from tenant's actions

clauses.title: Exculpation
clauses.sourceText: Tenant hereby waives any rights to bring a cause of action against the individuals executing this Lease on behalf of Landlord ... and all persons dealing with Landlord must look solely to Landlord's assets for the enforcement of any claim against Landlord...

clauses.title: Exhibit A - Rules and Regulations
clauses.sourceText: These Rules and Regulations are in addition to, and shall not be construed to in any way modify, alter or amend, in whole or in part, the terms, covenants, agreements and conditions of any Lease of Premises in the Building.

clauses.title: Exhibit B - Work Letter Agreement
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall furnish and install within the Premises substantially in accordance with plans and specifications approved by Tenant and Landlord ... The Tenant Allowance shall be the actual cost of said improvements to a limit of (not to exceed) Thirty and No/100 Dollars ($30.00) per rentable square foot ... The total Tenant Allowance for the Premises shall not exceed ... ($1,409,340.00).

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Security Deposit and First Month's Rent
clauses.sourceText: The Security Deposit in the amount of Seventy Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty Six and 89/100 Dollars ($77,826.89) and the First Month's Rent in the amount of Seventy Five Thousand Three Hundred Sixty and 54/100 Dollars ($75,360.54) are due and payable upon Lease execution by Tenant.

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Renewal Option
clauses.sourceText: Provided Tenant is not in default and as long as Tenant is still in occupancy of the Premises, Tenant shall have one (1) option to renew this Lease for the entire Premises for an additional sixty (60) month term with one hundred eighty (180) days prior written notice to Landlord of its intent to renew.

effect.action: may renew the lease for one additional 60-month term by giving prior written notice to landlord

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Right of First Refusal
clauses.sourceText: Provided Tenant is not in default ... Tenant shall have a right of refusal ... Upon receipt of written notice ... Tenant shall respond to Landlord within ten (10) business days whether Tenant intends to lease all of such space covered by the third-party offer at the Offer Terms.

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Termination Option
clauses.sourceText: Provided Tenant is not in default, Tenant may terminate this Lease at the end of the sixtieth (60th) full calendar month of the term, upon giving six (6) months' prior written notice to Landlord and paying to Landlord a termination fee equal to all unamortized tenant improvement costs, unamortized commissions ... and free rent.

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Parking
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall provide to Tenant, and Tenant shall have the right to use, without charge, on a nonexclusive, first come-first serve basis, 3.5 parking spaces ... per one thousand (1,000) square feet of usable area leased and occupied by Tenant.

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Signage
clauses.sourceText: So long as American Safety Insurance Services, Inc. occupies all of the Premises, Tenant shall have the right to install its name on the exterior monument sign for the Building ... All such signage shall be subject to the prior written approval of Landlord...

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Club Memberships
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall cause to be waived the initiation fees for (a) up to twenty-five (25) new memberships to the Galleria Athletic Club ... and (b) up to five (5) new memberships in The Georgian Club...

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Contingency
clauses.sourceText: This Lease and all rights and duties of the parties hereunder are expressly conditioned upon the sale, on or before October 19, 2006, by the current owner to an unrelated third party, of that certain office building located at 2323 Cumberland Boulevard Southeast, Atlanta, Georgia... If such sale does not occur ... this Lease shall be of no force and effect.

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Staffing
clauses.sourceText: Landlord agrees that the Building shall be staffed with not less than three (3) day porter employees ... Landlord shall provide full-time security officers and security vehicles to patrol the parking decks and common roadways, 24 hour a day, 7 days a week...

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Building Amenities
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall at all times throughout the term of this Lease use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the following amenities within the Building: (i) Sandwich shop; (ii) Newsstand; (iii) Building conference room with audio visual capabilities; and (iv) ATM.

clauses.title: Exhibit E - Confidentiality
clauses.sourceText: Tenant covenants and agrees ... to treat the terms of this Lease and all offers and related information delivered by Landlord to Tenant ... as confidential ... Tenant agrees to keep strictly confidential the Confidential Information...

clauses.title: Exhibit G - Insurance
clauses.sourceText: Tenant's policies shall include Commercial General Liability, Umbrella / Excess Liability, Workers Compensation, and Tenant Property coverage... Said policies or certificates thereof shall be delivered to Landlord and Landlord's property manager by Tenant upon commencement of the term of the Lease and upon each renewal of said insurance.
